content_sections.heading: About BBCI
content_sections.text: Dr. Bhubaneswar Borooah Cancer Institute is a cancer hospital and research institute at Gopinath Nagar, Guwahati, functioning under Tata Memorial Centre, Department of Atomic Energy, Govt. of India. These posts are for the institute's "Pediatric and Adult Haematolymphoid Unit" and are project positions, temporary and purely on contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates in current employment need an appointment letter, last month's pay slip and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) as their experience certificates. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: M.D. / D.N.B. (Paediatrics) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission.
rows.experience: Not specified in the notice as a requirement; the pay depends on years of experience

rows.qualification: 10+2 in Science and Certificate course of 06 months or 01 year Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology from a reputed Institute.

content_sections.text: The notice also states a general age relaxation: maximum by 5 years for TMC employees and employees working in TMC on temporary basis / under project / on contract basis etc. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age.

rows.age_limit: 40 years (Relaxable for experienced and deserving candidates)
30 years (5 years relaxable for in service candidates of TMC)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Both posts carry a consolidated salary. For the Consultant 'D' / Senior Resident (Pediatric Oncology) post, the monthly pay depends on experience: The notice does not mention any allowance on top of the consolidated salary. Place of posting: Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute, Guwahati. Duration: the appointment shall initially be for a period of six (06) months, which may be extended further solely on the basis of satisfactory performance. The appointment shall remain co-terminus with the project. The candidate shall have no right or claim for permanent employment under the project or at BBCI, nor any right to claim continuation of services in any other project or position. The selection will not be an employment on Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute's permanent pay-roll.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened first, and eligible candidates are called for an interview and/or written examination; the notice also mentions an MCQ, Skill Test and Viva. BBCI reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the Written Examination / Interview / Skill test to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience. It may fix a minimum eligibility standard or bench mark, considering factors such as the number of vacancies and percentage of marks in Graduate / Post Graduate Degrees, and may fix cut-off marks Group / Stream / Discipline / Category-wise. Merely meeting the prescribed qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called. BBCI also reserves the right not to call any candidate without assigning any reason. The list of shortlisted candidates for the MCQ / Skill Test / VIVA will be uploaded on the official website of Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute. The date of the interview or written examination will be sent by email to eligible candidates only. Cut-off marks may also be applied for final selection after the written test, interview or skill test, and the decision of the Director, BBCI, is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply through the "Online Application" link given in the notice (tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx); applications by any other mode are not invited. Use a valid email ID in the application, as all correspondence, including the interview or written examination date, will be by email only. Fill in the date of birth, qualification and experience details correctly, as originals will be checked against them later. Complete and submit the online application by 3 December 2026, up to 05:30 p.m. (IST). Incomplete and online non-submitted applications will be summarily rejected. For further enquiry, candidates may email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates called for the Interview / Written Examination / Skill Test must carry original documents along with one set of copies in support of the details in the online application: Identity proof (Aadhaar, PAN & Voter) Date of Birth: Birth Certificate / School leaving certificate / S.S.C passing certificate Educational Qualification: Mark sheet & Passing Certificate of final examination Experience (current employment): Appointment letter, Last month's Pay Slip and NOC Original testimonials for qualifications and experience Candidates who fail to bring these will not be allowed to appear for the interview, written examination or skill test.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If a candidate is found at any stage not to fulfil the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed any material fact, the candidature will be cancelled; if detected after appointment, services are liable to be terminated forthwith. BBCI does not take any responsibility for non-receipt of applications through Online. Receiving, downloading and printing related documents is the candidate's responsibility. Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Canvassing / bribing in any form will be a disqualification and would lead to cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 2 Consultant 'D' / Senior Resident (Pediatric Oncology) (Project) and 2 Technician 'C' (Biochemistry) (Project), in the Pediatric and Adult Haematolymphoid Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of online application is 3 December 2026, up to 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the BBCI Senior Resident (Pediatric Oncology) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.D. / D.N.B. (Paediatrics) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the BBCI Technician 'C' (Biochemistry) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need 10+2 in Science and a Certificate course of 06 months or 01 year Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology from a reputed Institute, plus 02 years' experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for Consultant 'D' / Senior Resident (relaxable for experienced and deserving candidates) and 30 years for Technician 'C' (5 years relaxable for in service candidates of TMC).

faq.question: Q6. Who gets age relaxation in BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TMC employees and employees working in TMC on temporary basis / under project / on contract basis get age relaxation up to a maximum of 5 years; the Senior Resident limit is also relaxable for experienced and deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of BBCI Senior Resident and Technician posts?
faq.answer: Consultant 'D' / Senior Resident gets a consolidated Rs. 1,28,000 to Rs. 1,40,000 per month depending on experience, and Technician 'C' gets Rs. 30,600 per month.

faq.question: Q8. How to apply for BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply only through the Online Application link on tmc.gov.in (frm_Registration.aspx) before 3 December 2026, 05:30 p.m., using a valid email ID.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are screened, and eligible candidates are called for an interview and/or written examination (MCQ / Skill Test / Viva); the shortlist is uploaded on the BBCI website and dates are sent by email.

faq.question: Q10. Are the BBCI posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are temporary and purely contractual, initially for six months, extendable on satisfactory performance and co-terminus with the project, with no claim to permanent employment.
